<objective>
Apply the gain in processBlock and add a real bypass parameter.

Purpose: makes the parameter audible; without this the phase delivers nothing a user can hear.
Output: audio attenuated by the set gain, and a bypass that passes audio through untouched.
</objective>

<context>

<tasks>

<task type="auto">
  <name>Task 1: Smooth and apply gain in processBlock</name>
  <files>Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, Source/PluginProcessor.h</files>
  <action>Hold a juce::SmoothedValue&lt;float, ValueSmoothingTypes::Linear&gt;, reset it in
  prepareToPlay with a 20 ms ramp, set its target once per block from the raw dB value
  converted with Decibels::decibelsToGain, then applyGain per channel. Allocate nothing
  in processBlock.</action>
  <verify>cmake --build build --config Release && ctest --test-dir build -R Gain</verify>
  <done>A -6 dB setting halves the signal amplitude in the offline render test</done>
</task>

<task type="auto">
  <name>Task 2: Add bypass parameter</name>
  <files>Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, Source/ParamIDs.h</files>
  <action>Add a bool parameter `bypass`. When true, return from processBlock before the
  gain stage. Do not clear the buffer — bypass must be bit-identical passthrough.</action>
  <verify>ctest --test-dir build -R Bypass</verify>
  <done>Null test of bypassed output against input is bit-identical</done>
</task>
